answer: The basalt's isotopic signature and quartz lattice defects are unforgeable per site, and the ferrous casing carries a bonded serial. Each agent must stake a physical proof-of-work token: a ferrous disc embedded with quartz and basalt grains mined from a registered site. Duplicating identities requires acquiring and registering new mineral stock, a costly real-world bottleneck, while honest participants amortize stake across epochs. From sa0006's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
